integrity: The published tables are regenerated from eight-bit local truth tables and exact integer polynomial identities; no empirical extrapolation to infinite time or unbounded spatial lengths is used.
scientific_limitations: The complete data concern finite cyclic spatial rings and temporal periods one and two only. The full text of the most directly related 2026 ECA spectral classification could not be inspected, leaving an unresolved bibliographic priority risk. The finite 256-rule census is reproducible exactly but has not received independent review.
title: Complete temporal-two ring zeta classification for elementary cellular automata
